decisions.reason: It is the peace Christ gives (John 14:27) and made by his cross (1:20). They were called to it "in one body", so it is peace with one another as well as peace of heart.

decisions.choice: follow SBLGNT: "the peace of Christ"
decisions.reason: Many later manuscripts read "God", as in Philippians 4:7. The meaning is close either way.

decisions.choice: {{christos:Christ|Messiah}}
decisions.reason: Title setting. Literal keeps the article: "the [[CL]]".

decisions.choice: be the umpire
decisions.reason: Balanced keeps the picture of the umpire (m1).

decisions.choice: God called you to live in peace as one body
alternatives: to which you were called in one body
decisions.reason: Readable names God as the one who called them, as in 1:12-13.

decisions.choice: règne en arbitre (L); soit l’arbitre (B)
decisions.reason: The verb is the umpire's decision (m1), from the same family as "disqualifier" in 2:18. Literal adds "en arbitre" so the picture is not lost in a plain "règne".

decisions.choice: "평안" (key term) at every level
decisions.reason: The key term takes "평안", the peace Christ gives, as in the greeting (1:2) and in John. It covers peace among them as well as within them, which the meaning decision asks for. "평화" is used for the verb "make peace" in 1:20.

decisions.choice: seja o árbitro
decisions.reason: Balanced keeps the picture of m1, the umpire who decides a contest. "Árbitro" is the everyday Brazilian word for a referee, so the picture is plain; Literal says "governe", as the English Literal says "rule".

source.text: ὁ λόγος τοῦ Χριστοῦ ἐνοικείτω ἐν ὑμῖν πλουσίως ἐν πάσῃ σοφίᾳ· διδάσκοντες καὶ νουθετοῦντες ἑαυτοὺς ψαλμοῖς, ὕμνοις, ᾠδαῖς πνευματικαῖς ἐν χάριτι, ᾄδοντες ἐν ταῖς καρδίαις ὑμῶν τῷ θεῷ·

records.literal_gloss: The word of the Christ let dwell in you richly in all wisdom; teaching and admonishing yourselves in psalms, hymns, songs spiritual, in grace, singing in the hearts of you to the God;

en.L: Let the word of the {{christos:Christ|Messiah}} dwell in you richly in all wisdom, teaching and admonishing one another with psalms, hymns, [and] spiritual songs, singing with gratitude in your hearts to God.
en.B: Let the word of {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} make its home among you richly, in all wisdom. Teach and warn one another with psalms, hymns and Spirit-given songs, and sing to God, thankful from the heart.
en.R: Let the message of {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} fill your lives and make you wise. Teach each other and help each other do right with psalms, hymns and other songs that God's Spirit gives. Sing to God with thankful hearts.

es.L: Que la palabra del {{christos:Cristo|Mesías}} habite en {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} ricamente en toda sabiduría, {{plural_you:enseñándose|enseñándoos}} y {{plural_you:amonestándose|amonestándoos}} unos a otros con salmos, himnos, [y] cantos espirituales, cantando con gratitud en {{plural_you:sus|vuestros}} corazones a Dios.
es.B: Que la palabra {{christos:de Cristo|del Mesías}} haga su hogar entre {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} con abundancia, en toda sabiduría. {{plural_you:Enséñense|Enseñaos}} y {{plural_you:corríjanse|corregíos}} unos a otros con salmos, himnos y cantos dados por el Espíritu, y {{plural_you:canten|cantad}} a Dios con gratitud desde el corazón.
es.R: Que el mensaje {{christos:de Cristo|del Mesías}} llene {{plural_you:sus|vuestras}} vidas y {{plural_you:los|os}} haga sabios. {{plural_you:Enséñense|Enseñaos}} y {{plural_you:ayúdense|ayudaos}} unos a otros a hacer el bien con salmos, himnos y otros cantos que da el Espíritu de Dios. {{plural_you:Canten|Cantad}} a Dios con el corazón lleno de gratitud.

fr.L: Que la parole du {{christos:Christ|Messie}} habite en vous richement en toute sagesse, vous enseignant et vous avertissant les uns les autres par des psaumes, des hymnes, des chants spirituels, chantant avec reconnaissance dans vos cœurs à Dieu.
fr.B: Que la parole du {{christos:Christ|Messie}} fasse sa demeure parmi vous avec toute sa richesse, en toute sagesse. Enseignez-vous et avertissez-vous les uns les autres par des psaumes, des hymnes et des chants inspirés par l’Esprit, et chantez à Dieu, le cœur plein de reconnaissance.
fr.R: Que le message du {{christos:Christ|Messie}} remplisse votre vie et vous rende sages. Enseignez-vous les uns les autres et aidez-vous à faire le bien par des psaumes, des hymnes et d’autres chants que donne l’Esprit de Dieu. Chantez à Dieu avec un cœur reconnaissant.

sw.L: Neno la {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} likae kwa utajiri ndani yenu katika hekima yote, huku mkifundishana na kuonyana kwa zaburi, nyimbo za sifa, [na] nyimbo za kiroho, mkimwimbia Mungu kwa shukrani katika mioyo yenu.
sw.B: Neno la {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} lifanye makao yake kwa wingi kati yenu, kwa hekima yote. Fundishaneni na kuonyana kwa zaburi, nyimbo za sifa na nyimbo anazotoa Roho, na mwimbieni Mungu kwa shukrani kutoka moyoni.
sw.R: Ujumbe wa {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} ujaze maisha yenu na kuwapa hekima. Fundishaneni na kusaidiana kutenda mema kwa zaburi, nyimbo za sifa na nyimbo nyingine ambazo Roho wa Mungu huwapa. Mwimbieni Mungu kwa mioyo yenye shukrani.

vi.L: Hãy để lời của {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}} cư ngụ cách dồi dào trong anh chị em trong mọi sự khôn ngoan, dạy dỗ và khuyên răn lẫn nhau bằng thi thiên, thánh ca, [và] những bài ca thuộc linh, với lòng biết ơn mà hát trong lòng mình cho Đức Chúa Trời.
vi.B: Hãy để lời của {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}} ngự cách dồi dào giữa anh chị em, trong mọi sự khôn ngoan. Hãy dạy dỗ và khuyên bảo nhau bằng thi thiên, thánh ca và những bài ca do Thánh Linh ban cho, và hãy hát cho Đức Chúa Trời với lòng biết ơn từ tận đáy lòng.
vi.R: Hãy để sứ điệp của {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}} đầy dẫy trong đời sống anh chị em và làm cho anh chị em khôn ngoan. Hãy dạy dỗ nhau và giúp nhau làm điều đúng bằng những bài thi thiên, thánh ca, và những bài ca khác mà Thánh Linh của Đức Chúa Trời ban cho. Hãy hát cho Đức Chúa Trời với tấm lòng biết ơn.

ko.L: {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}의 말씀이 모든 지혜로 여러분 안에 풍성히 거하게 하십시오. 시편과 찬송과 영적인 노래로 서로 가르치고 훈계하며, 감사하는 마음으로 여러분의 마음속에서 하나님께 노래하십시오.
ko.B: {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}의 말씀이 모든 지혜와 함께 여러분 가운데 풍성히 자리 잡게 하십시오. 시편과 찬송과 성령께서 주시는 노래로 서로 가르치고 깨우치며, 감사하는 마음으로 하나님께 노래하십시오.
ko.R: {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}의 말씀이 여러분의 삶을 가득 채우게 하여 여러분을 지혜롭게 하십시오. 시편과 찬송과 하나님의 성령께서 주시는 여러 노래로 서로 가르치고, 바르게 살도록 서로 도우십시오. 감사하는 마음으로 하나님께 노래하십시오.

pt.L: Que a palavra do {{christos:Cristo|Messias}} habite ricamente em vocês, em toda sabedoria, ensinando e advertindo uns aos outros com salmos, hinos [e] cânticos espirituais, cantando com gratidão, no coração de vocês, a Deus.
pt.B: Que a palavra {{christos:de Cristo|do Messias}} faça morada entre vocês com riqueza, em toda a sabedoria. Ensinem e advirtam uns aos outros com salmos, hinos e cânticos dados pelo Espírito, e cantem a Deus com gratidão no coração.
pt.R: Deixem que a mensagem {{christos:de Cristo|do Messias}} encha a vida de vocês e torne vocês sábios. Ensinem uns aos outros e ajudem uns aos outros a fazer o que é certo, com salmos, hinos e outros cânticos que o Espírito de Deus dá. Cantem a Deus com o coração agradecido.

am.L: {{christos:የክርስቶስ|የመሲሑ}} ቃል በጥበብ ሁሉ በባለጠግነት ይኑርባችሁ፤ በመዝሙራት፣ በውዳሴዎች፣ በመንፈሳዊ ዝማሬዎችም እርስ በርሳችሁ እያስተማራችሁና እየገሠጻችሁ፣ በልባችሁ በምስጋና ለእግዚአብሔር እየዘመራችሁ።
am.B: {{christos:የክርስቶስ|የመሲሑ}} ቃል በመካከላችሁ በብዛት መኖሪያውን ያድርግ፤ በጥበብም ሁሉ ይሁን። በመዝሙራት፣ በውዳሴዎችና መንፈስ በሚሰጣቸው ዝማሬዎች እርስ በርሳችሁ ተማማሩ፤ ተመካከሩም፤ ከልብ በማመስገንም ለእግዚአብሔር ዘምሩ።
am.R: {{christos:የክርስቶስ|የመሲሑ}} መልእክት ሕይወታችሁን ይሙላ፤ ጥበበኞችም ያድርጋችሁ። በመዝሙራት፣ በውዳሴዎችና የእግዚአብሔር መንፈስ በሚሰጣቸው ሌሎች ዝማሬዎች እርስ በርሳችሁ ተማማሩ፤ ትክክለኛውን ነገር እንድታደርጉም ተረዳዱ። በአመስጋኝ ልብ ለእግዚአብሔር ዘምሩ።

decisions.choice: the word of Christ: the message about him, which is also his own word
decisions.reason: λόγος τοῦ Χριστοῦ can mean the message about Christ (the gospel, 1:5) or what Christ says; the two are one. It is to "dwell" among them, the verb used for God's fullness in Christ (2:9) in a related form.

decisions.choice: in all wisdom goes with "dwell"
alternatives: in all wisdom goes with "teaching and admonishing"
decisions.reason: The SBLGNT puts a raised dot after σοφίᾳ, so the wisdom goes with the word dwelling among them. Without it, the words could begin the next clause: "teaching ... in all wisdom", as in 1:28.

decisions.choice: psalms, hymns and spiritual songs: every kind of song the church sings
decisions.reason: The three words overlap. Psalms may be those of the Old Testament, hymns songs of praise to God, and songs any other sung words; "spiritual" probably covers all three as given by the Spirit. Verses like 1:15-20 may give an idea of such songs.

decisions.choice: with gratitude
decisions.reason: χάριτι is the word for grace, but it can also mean thanks (it is the word in 2 Corinthians 9:15, "thanks be to God"). With "be thankful" in verse 15 and "giving thanks" in verse 17, gratitude is likely here. It could also mean singing by God's grace.

decisions.choice: follow SBLGNT: "the word of Christ"
decisions.reason: Some manuscripts read "God" or "the Lord". "Christ" fits the run of verses 15-17.

decisions.choice: {{christos:Christ|Messiah}}
decisions.reason: Title setting. Literal keeps the article: "the [[CL]]".

decisions.choice: make its home
decisions.reason: "Dwell" says the same in older English; Balanced uses everyday words.

decisions.choice: make you wise; help each other do right
decisions.reason: Readable turns "in all wisdom" and "admonishing" into plain words.

decisions.choice: avec reconnaissance (L); le cœur plein de reconnaissance (B)
decisions.reason: The word is the one for grace, but here it means thanks (m4). French "avec grâce" would say "gracefully", so every level says thanks.

decisions.choice: "với lòng biết ơn" for "in grace" at every level
decisions.reason: The Greek word is the one for grace, but here it means thanks (m4). "Ân điển" is kept for grace as a key term, so it is not used where the sense is gratitude.

decisions.choice: "감사하는 마음으로" for the word for grace
decisions.reason: The word is the one for grace, but here the meaning decision reads it as gratitude, beside "be thankful" (verse 15) and "giving thanks" (verse 17). Korean "은혜" never means thanks, so every level says "감사하는 마음으로", as the English says "with gratitude".

decisions.choice: መዝሙራት, ውዳሴዎች, መንፈሳዊ ዝማሬዎች (psalms, hymns, spiritual songs)
decisions.reason: Three words for the church's songs (meaning decision m3): "መዝሙራት" are the Psalms, "ውዳሴ" a song of praise, and "ዝማሬ" a song sung; Balanced and Readable say the last are songs the Spirit gives.

source.text: καὶ πᾶν ὅ τι ἐὰν ποιῆτε ἐν λόγῳ ἢ ἐν ἔργῳ, πάντα ἐν ὀνόματι κυρίου Ἰησοῦ, εὐχαριστοῦντες τῷ θεῷ πατρὶ δι’ αὐτοῦ.

records.literal_gloss: And everything whatever you do in word or in deed, all [things] in [the] name of [the] Lord Jesus, giving thanks to the God Father through him.

en.L: And whatever you do, in word or in deed, [do] everything in [the] name of [the] Lord Jesus, giving thanks to God [the] Father through {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.
en.B: In everything you say and everything you do, act in the name of the Lord Jesus, and through {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} give thanks to God the Father.
en.R: Whatever you say and whatever you do, do it as people who belong to the Lord Jesus. And through {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} always thank God the Father.

es.L: Y todo lo que {{plural_you:hagan|hagáis}}, de palabra o de obra, [{{plural_you:háganlo|hacedlo}}] todo en [el] nombre del Señor Jesús, dando gracias a Dios Padre por medio de {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}.
es.B: En todo lo que {{plural_you:digan|digáis}} y en todo lo que {{plural_you:hagan|hagáis}}, {{plural_you:actúen|actuad}} en el nombre del Señor Jesús, y por medio de {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} {{plural_you:den|dad}} gracias a Dios Padre.
es.R: Todo lo que {{plural_you:digan|digáis}} y todo lo que {{plural_you:hagan|hagáis}}, {{plural_you:háganlo|hacedlo}} como personas que pertenecen al Señor Jesús. Y por medio de {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} {{plural_you:den|dad}} siempre gracias a Dios Padre.

fr.L: Et tout ce que vous faites, en parole ou en œuvre, [faites] tout au nom du Seigneur Jésus, rendant grâce à Dieu le Père par {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}.
fr.B: Dans tout ce que vous dites et dans tout ce que vous faites, agissez au nom du Seigneur Jésus, et par {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} rendez grâce à Dieu le Père.
fr.R: Quoi que vous disiez et quoi que vous fassiez, faites-le comme des gens qui appartiennent au Seigneur Jésus. Et par {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}, remerciez toujours Dieu le Père.

sw.L: Na lolote mtakalofanya, [iwe] kwa neno au kwa tendo, [fanyeni] mambo yote kwa jina la Bwana Yesu, huku mkimpa Mungu Baba shukrani kupitia {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}}.
sw.B: Katika yote mnayosema na yote mnayotenda, tendeni kwa jina la Bwana Yesu, na kupitia {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} mshukuruni Mungu Baba.
sw.R: Lolote mnalosema na lolote mnalofanya, fanyeni kama watu walio wa Bwana Yesu. Na kupitia {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} mshukuruni Mungu Baba siku zote.

vi.L: Và bất cứ điều gì anh chị em làm, bằng lời nói hay bằng việc làm, [hãy làm] mọi điều trong danh Chúa Giê-xu, nhờ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} mà tạ ơn Đức Chúa Trời là Cha.
vi.B: Trong mọi điều anh chị em nói và mọi điều anh chị em làm, hãy làm nhân danh Chúa Giê-xu, và nhờ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} mà tạ ơn Đức Chúa Trời, là Cha.
vi.R: Bất cứ điều gì anh chị em nói và bất cứ điều gì anh chị em làm, hãy làm như những người thuộc về Chúa Giê-xu. Và hãy luôn nhờ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} mà cảm tạ Đức Chúa Trời, là Cha.

ko.L: 그리고 말로나 행동으로나 무엇을 하든지, 모든 것을 주 예수의 이름으로 [하고], 그분을 통하여 아버지 하나님께 감사하십시오.
ko.B: 여러분이 하는 모든 말과 모든 행동을 주 예수의 이름으로 하고, 그분을 통해 아버지 하나님께 감사를 드리십시오.
ko.R: 무슨 말을 하든지 무슨 일을 하든지, 주 예수께 속한 사람으로서 하십시오. 그리고 그분을 통해 언제나 아버지 하나님께 감사드리십시오.

pt.L: E tudo o que vocês fizerem, em palavra ou em ação, [façam] tudo em nome do Senhor Jesus, dando graças a Deus Pai por meio {{deity_pronoun:dele|Dele}}.
pt.B: Em tudo o que disserem e em tudo o que fizerem, ajam em nome do Senhor Jesus, e por meio {{deity_pronoun:dele|Dele}} deem graças a Deus Pai.
pt.R: Tudo o que vocês disserem e tudo o que fizerem, façam como pessoas que pertencem ao Senhor Jesus. E, por meio {{deity_pronoun:dele|Dele}}, agradeçam sempre a Deus Pai.

am.L: በቃልም ሆነ በሥራ የምታደርጉትን ሁሉ፣ ሁሉን በጌታ በኢየሱስ ስም [አድርጉት]፤ በእርሱም በኩል እግዚአብሔር አብን እያመሰገናችሁ።
am.B: የምትናገሩትንም ሆነ የምታደርጉትን ሁሉ በጌታ በኢየሱስ ስም አድርጉ፤ በእርሱም በኩል እግዚአብሔር አብን አመስግኑ።
am.R: የምትናገሩትንም ሆነ የምታደርጉትን ሁሉ የጌታ የኢየሱስ እንደ ሆኑ ሰዎች አድርጉት። በእርሱም በኩል ሁልጊዜ እግዚአብሔር አብን አመስግኑ።

decisions.choice: in the name of the Lord Jesus: as his people, under his authority
decisions.reason: To act "in the name" of someone is to act as one who belongs to them and represents them. Every word and deed is to be one Jesus can own.

decisions.choice: all: do everything
decisions.reason: The verb is left to be understood.

decisions.choice: through him: Jesus is the one through whom thanks reaches God
decisions.reason: Thanks is given to God the Father, and given through Jesus, by whom they have come to God (1:12-14).

decisions.choice: [do]
decisions.reason: The Greek leaves the verb to be understood (m2).

decisions.choice: as people who belong to the Lord Jesus
alternatives: in the name of the Lord Jesus
decisions.reason: Readable explains the idiom (m1).

decisions.choice: "trong danh" (L); "nhân danh" (B)
decisions.reason: As in the Vietnamese John (14:13): Literal keeps the preposition, Balanced uses "nhân danh", the Vietnamese for acting on someone's authority. Readable explains the idiom (m1).

source.text: Αἱ γυναῖκες, ὑποτάσσεσθε τοῖς ἀνδράσιν, ὡς ἀνῆκεν ἐν κυρίῳ.

records.literal_gloss: The wives, submit to the husbands, as it is fitting in [the] Lord.

en.L: Wives, submit to [your] husbands, as is fitting in [the] Lord.
en.B: Wives, submit to your husbands; this is fitting for those who belong to the Lord.
en.R: Wives, submit to your husbands, as is right for those who belong to the Lord.

es.L: Esposas, {{plural_you:sométanse|someteos}} a [{{plural_you:sus|vuestros}}] maridos, como conviene en [el] Señor.
es.B: Esposas, {{plural_you:sométanse|someteos}} a {{plural_you:sus|vuestros}} maridos; esto es lo apropiado para quienes pertenecen al Señor.
es.R: Esposas, {{plural_you:dejen|dejad}} que {{plural_you:sus|vuestros}} maridos {{plural_you:las|os}} guíen, como es correcto para quienes pertenecen al Señor.

fr.L: Femmes, soumettez-vous à [vos] maris, comme il convient dans le Seigneur.
fr.B: Femmes, soumettez-vous à votre mari : c’est ce qui convient à celles qui appartiennent au Seigneur.
fr.R: Femmes, soumettez-vous à votre mari, comme il est juste pour celles qui appartiennent au Seigneur.

sw.L: Ninyi wake, jitiisheni kwa waume [wenu], kama ilivyo sawa katika Bwana.
sw.B: Ninyi wake, jitiisheni chini ya waume wenu; hivyo ndivyo inavyowafaa wale walio wa Bwana.
sw.R: Ninyi wake, fuateni uongozi wa waume wenu, kama inavyofaa kwa watu walio wa Bwana.

vi.L: Những người làm vợ, hãy thuận phục chồng [mình], như điều xứng hợp trong Chúa.
vi.B: Người làm vợ hãy thuận phục chồng mình; điều đó là xứng hợp cho những người thuộc về Chúa.
vi.R: Người làm vợ, hãy thuận phục chồng mình, vì đó là điều đúng đối với những người thuộc về Chúa.

ko.L: 아내 여러분, 남편에게 복종하십시오. 이것이 주님 안에서 마땅한 일입니다.
ko.B: 아내 여러분, 남편에게 스스로 복종하십시오. 이것이 주님께 속한 사람들에게 마땅한 일입니다.
ko.R: 아내 여러분, 기꺼이 남편에게 복종하십시오. 그것이 주님께 속한 사람들에게 옳은 일입니다.

pt.L: Esposas, submetam-se aos [seus] maridos, como convém no Senhor.
pt.B: Esposas, submetam-se aos seus maridos; isso é o que convém aos que pertencem ao Senhor.
pt.R: Esposas, submetam-se aos seus maridos, como é certo para quem pertence ao Senhor.

am.L: ሚስቶች ሆይ፣ በጌታ እንደሚገባ ለባሎቻችሁ ተገዙ።
am.B: ሚስቶች ሆይ፣ ለባሎቻችሁ ተገዙ፤ ይህ የጌታ ለሆኑት ተገቢ ነው።
am.R: ሚስቶች ሆይ፣ የጌታ ለሆኑ ሰዎች ትክክል እንደ ሆነ ለባሎቻችሁ ተገዙ።

decisions.choice: the household rules: Paul speaks to each member of the household
decisions.reason: Writers of the time set out the duties of household members (Aristotle, Politics 1.3), usually addressed to the man at its head. Paul speaks directly to wives, children and slaves as people answerable to the Lord, and gives husbands, fathers and masters duties too (3:19, 3:21, 4:1).

decisions.choice: submit: place oneself under, by one's own choice
decisions.reason: ὑποτάσσεσθε is middle: an act of the wife's own will. It is a different verb from "obey", which Paul uses for children and slaves (3:20, 3:22). In Ephesians 5:21 the same verb is used of all believers toward one another.

decisions.choice: as is fitting in the Lord: the measure is life in the Lord
alternatives: as is fitting by social custom
decisions.reason: ἀνῆκεν means what is proper or due. "In the Lord" makes life with Christ the measure, which both grounds the instruction and sets its limits.

decisions.choice: for those who belong to the Lord
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what "in the Lord" means here.

decisions.choice: soumettez-vous
decisions.reason: The verb is middle, an act of the wife's own will (m2). The reflexive "soumettez-vous" says that; "soyez soumises" reads as a state imposed on her. Balanced and Readable use the singular "votre mari", the usual French when each person has one.

decisions.choice: "Người làm vợ", "người làm chồng", "con cái", "người làm cha", "những người làm nô lệ", "những người làm chủ" for the households addressed in 3:18-4:1
decisions.reason: Vietnamese names a group it addresses by its role ("người làm ..."), which is respectful without being archaic; "hỡi" belongs to older and liturgical speech. Where a pronoun is needed, Paul still says "anh chị em" to the slaves (3:22-24), who are members of the church like the rest.

decisions.choice: "thuận phục" for the wives; "vâng lời" for the children and slaves (3:20, 3:22)
decisions.reason: Paul uses two different verbs (m2), and Vietnamese keeps them apart: "thuận phục" is to place oneself under someone willingly, "vâng lời" is to obey. "Phục tùng" sounds like forced submission.

decisions.choice: each group addressed as "... 여러분" in the 합쇼체 of the letter: "아내 여러분", "남편 여러분", "자녀 여러분", "아버지 여러분", "노예 여러분", "주인 여러분" (3:18-4:1)
alternatives: 해라체 commands to children and slaves
decisions.reason: The household rules speak to each member of the church directly, as people answerable to the Lord (the meaning decision). Keeping one speech level and the same respectful address for wives, children and slaves as for husbands, fathers and masters lets the Korean show that; plainer commands to children or slaves would put a rank into the text that Paul does not.

decisions.choice: "복종하다" for submitting (L); "스스로 복종하다" (B); "기꺼이 복종하다" (R); "순종하다" for obeying in 3:20 and 3:22
decisions.reason: The meaning decision says this is a different verb from "obey" and an act of the wife's own will. Korean keeps the two verbs apart, "복종하다" (place oneself under) here and "순종하다" (obey) for children and slaves, and Balanced and Readable add "스스로" and "기꺼이" to bring out the middle voice. "복종" can sound harsher in current Korean than the Greek; a reviewer may prefer another verb.

decisions.choice: Esposas; submetam-se
decisions.reason: The Greek word means "women" or "wives"; set beside "maridos" it means wives, and Portuguese "Esposas" says so where "Mulheres" would be read as all women. "Submetam-se" is the current word for the middle verb of m2, an act of the wife's own will; it is kept apart from "obedeçam", used for children and slaves in verses 20 and 22. "Sujeitar-se" sounds older and harsher.

decisions.choice: ተገዙ (submit, place yourselves under)
decisions.reason: Meaning decision m2: placing oneself under another by one's own choice. "ተገዙ" says that; "ታዘዙ" (obey) is kept for the different Greek verb said to children and slaves in verses 20 and 22.

source.text: οἱ ἄνδρες, ἀγαπᾶτε τὰς γυναῖκας καὶ μὴ πικραίνεσθε πρὸς αὐτάς.

records.literal_gloss: The husbands, love the wives and do not be bitter toward them.

en.L: Husbands, love [your] wives and do not be bitter toward them.
en.B: Husbands, love your wives and never turn harsh or bitter against them.
en.R: Husbands, love your wives. Never be unkind or bitter toward them.

es.L: Maridos, {{plural_you:amen|amad}} a [{{plural_you:sus|vuestras}}] esposas y no {{plural_you:se amarguen|os amarguéis}} contra ellas.
es.B: Maridos, {{plural_you:amen|amad}} a {{plural_you:sus|vuestras}} esposas y nunca {{plural_you:se vuelvan|os volváis}} duros ni amargados con ellas.
es.R: Maridos, {{plural_you:amen|amad}} a {{plural_you:sus|vuestras}} esposas. Nunca las {{plural_you:traten|tratéis}} con dureza ni con rencor.

fr.L: Maris, aimez [vos] femmes et ne soyez pas amers envers elles.
fr.B: Maris, aimez votre femme et ne devenez jamais durs ou amers envers elle.
fr.R: Maris, aimez votre femme. Ne soyez jamais méchants ou amers avec elle.

sw.L: Ninyi waume, wapendeni wake [wenu], wala msiwakasirikie kwa uchungu.
sw.B: Ninyi waume, wapendeni wake wenu, na kamwe msiwe wakali wala wenye chuki kwao.
sw.R: Ninyi waume, wapendeni wake wenu. Kamwe msiwatendee kwa ukali wala kwa uchungu.

vi.L: Những người làm chồng, hãy yêu thương vợ [mình] và đừng cay nghiệt với họ.
vi.B: Người làm chồng hãy yêu thương vợ mình, và đừng bao giờ trở nên khắc nghiệt hay cay đắng với vợ.
vi.R: Người làm chồng, hãy yêu thương vợ mình. Đừng bao giờ đối xử không tử tế hay cay nghiệt với vợ.

ko.L: 남편 여러분, 아내를 사랑하고 아내에게 쓴 마음을 품지 마십시오.
ko.B: 남편 여러분, 아내를 사랑하고, 결코 아내에게 거칠거나 모질게 대하지 마십시오.
ko.R: 남편 여러분, 아내를 사랑하십시오. 아내에게 절대로 불친절하게 하거나 모질게 대하지 마십시오.

pt.L: Maridos, amem as [suas] esposas e não sejam amargos com elas.
pt.B: Maridos, amem as suas esposas e nunca se tornem ásperos nem amargos com elas.
pt.R: Maridos, amem as suas esposas. Nunca sejam duros nem amargos com elas.

am.L: ባሎች ሆይ፣ ሚስቶቻችሁን ውደዱ፤ በእነርሱም ላይ አትምረሩ።
am.B: ባሎች ሆይ፣ ሚስቶቻችሁን ውደዱ፤ ፈጽሞ አትጨክኑባቸው፤ አትምረሩባቸውም።
am.R: ባሎች ሆይ፣ ሚስቶቻችሁን ውደዱ። ፈጽሞ አትጨክኑባቸው፤ ክፉም አትሁኑባቸው።

decisions.choice: love: self-giving love
decisions.reason: ἀγαπάω is the love God shows and asks of his people. It is not a usual word in household rules of the time; Ephesians 5:25 measures it by Christ's love for the church.

decisions.choice: be bitter: grow resentful, or treat harshly
decisions.reason: πικραίνω means to make or become bitter. Husbands are not to let resentment turn into harsh treatment.

source.text: Τὰ τέκνα, ὑπακούετε τοῖς γονεῦσιν κατὰ πάντα, τοῦτο γὰρ εὐάρεστόν ἐστιν ἐν κυρίῳ.

records.literal_gloss: The children, obey the parents in all things, this for pleasing is in [the] Lord.

en.L: Children, obey [your] parents in all things, for this is pleasing in [the] Lord.
en.B: Children, do what your parents tell you in everything, for that is what is pleasing in the Lord.
en.R: Children, always obey your parents. This is what the Lord wants.

es.L: Hijos, {{plural_you:obedezcan|obedeced}} a [{{plural_you:sus|vuestros}}] padres en todo, porque esto es agradable en [el] Señor.
es.B: Hijos, en todo {{plural_you:hagan|haced}} lo que {{plural_you:sus|vuestros}} padres {{plural_you:les|os}} digan, porque eso es lo que agrada en el Señor.
es.R: Hijos, {{plural_you:obedezcan|obedeced}} siempre a {{plural_you:sus|vuestros}} padres. Esto es lo que el Señor quiere.

fr.L: Enfants, obéissez à [vos] parents en toutes choses, car cela est agréable dans le Seigneur.
fr.B: Enfants, faites en tout ce que vos parents vous disent, car c’est ce qui plaît dans le Seigneur.
fr.R: Enfants, obéissez toujours à vos parents. C’est ce que le Seigneur veut.

sw.L: Ninyi watoto, watiini wazazi [wenu] kwa kila jambo, kwa sababu hilo ni jambo la kupendeza katika Bwana.
sw.B: Ninyi watoto, fanyeni yote wazazi wenu wanayowaambia, kwa maana hilo ndilo linalopendeza katika Bwana.
sw.R: Ninyi watoto, watiini wazazi wenu siku zote. Hivyo ndivyo Bwana anavyotaka.

vi.L: Con cái, hãy vâng lời cha mẹ [mình] trong mọi sự, vì điều này là đẹp lòng trong Chúa.
vi.B: Con cái hãy vâng lời cha mẹ trong mọi sự, vì điều đó là đẹp lòng trong Chúa.
vi.R: Các con hãy luôn luôn vâng lời cha mẹ. Đó là điều Chúa muốn.

ko.L: 자녀 여러분, 모든 일에 부모에게 순종하십시오. 이것이 주님 안에서 기쁨이 되는 일입니다.
ko.B: 자녀 여러분, 모든 일에서 부모의 말을 따르십시오. 그것이 주님 안에서 기쁨이 되는 일입니다.
ko.R: 자녀 여러분, 언제나 부모님께 순종하십시오. 이것이 주님께서 원하시는 일입니다.

pt.L: Filhos, obedeçam aos [seus] pais em tudo, pois isto é agradável no Senhor.
pt.B: Filhos, façam em tudo o que os seus pais mandam, pois isso é o que agrada no Senhor.
pt.R: Filhos, obedeçam sempre aos seus pais. É isso que o Senhor quer.

am.L: ልጆች ሆይ፣ በሁሉ ነገር ለወላጆቻችሁ ታዘዙ፤ ይህ በጌታ ደስ የሚያሰኝ ነውና።
am.B: ልጆች ሆይ፣ ወላጆቻችሁ የሚሏችሁን በሁሉ ነገር አድርጉ፤ ይህ በጌታ ዘንድ ደስ የሚያሰኝ ነውና።
am.R: ልጆች ሆይ፣ ሁልጊዜ ለወላጆቻችሁ ታዘዙ። ጌታ የሚፈልገው ይህን ነው።

decisions.choice: children: present when the letter was read
decisions.reason: The letter was read aloud to the gathered church (4:16), so children heard themselves addressed as members of it.

decisions.choice: in all things: a general rule, within life in the Lord
decisions.reason: κατὰ πάντα states the rule broadly; Ephesians 6:1 puts it "in the Lord", and verse 21 sets limits on the parents' side.

decisions.choice: pleasing in the Lord: what pleases the Lord among his people
decisions.reason: ἐν κυρίῳ may mean "to the Lord" or "among those in the Lord"; either way the Lord's pleasure is the reason.

decisions.choice: This is what the Lord wants
alternatives: this is pleasing in the Lord
decisions.reason: Readable puts the reason simply.

decisions.choice: "Các con" (R) to the children
decisions.reason: Children hearing the letter read (m1) are spoken to as an elder speaks to children, "các con"; Literal and Balanced keep the noun "con cái", the word for children as a group, as for the other members of the household.

source.text: οἱ πατέρες, μὴ ἐρεθίζετε τὰ τέκνα ὑμῶν, ἵνα μὴ ἀθυμῶσιν.

records.literal_gloss: The fathers, do not provoke the children of you, so that not they lose heart.

en.L: Fathers, do not provoke your children, so that they do not lose heart.
en.B: Fathers, do not keep provoking your children, or they will lose heart.
en.R: Fathers, do not keep making your children angry, or they will give up trying.

es.L: Padres, no {{plural_you:provoquen|provoquéis}} a {{plural_you:sus|vuestros}} hijos, para que no se desanimen.
es.B: Padres, no {{plural_you:estén|estéis}} siempre irritando a {{plural_you:sus|vuestros}} hijos, o perderán el ánimo.
es.R: Padres, no {{plural_you:hagan|hagáis}} enojar a {{plural_you:sus|vuestros}} hijos una y otra vez, o dejarán de esforzarse.

fr.L: Pères, n’irritez pas vos enfants, afin qu’ils ne se découragent pas.
fr.B: Pères, ne provoquez pas sans cesse vos enfants, sinon ils perdront courage.
fr.R: Pères, ne mettez pas sans arrêt vos enfants en colère, sinon ils vont se décourager.

sw.L: Akina baba, msiwaudhi watoto wenu, ili wasife moyo.
sw.B: Akina baba, msiendelee kuwaudhi watoto wenu, la sivyo watakufa moyo.
sw.R: Akina baba, msiwakasirishe watoto wenu tena na tena, la sivyo wataacha kujaribu.

vi.L: Những người làm cha, đừng chọc giận con cái mình, để chúng khỏi ngã lòng.
vi.B: Người làm cha, đừng cứ chọc giận con cái mình, kẻo chúng ngã lòng.
vi.R: Người làm cha, đừng cứ làm cho con cái mình bực tức, kẻo chúng nản lòng mà bỏ cuộc.

ko.L: 아버지 여러분, 여러분의 자녀를 자극하지 마십시오. 그들이 낙심하지 않게 하려는 것입니다.
ko.B: 아버지 여러분, 자녀를 자꾸 자극하지 마십시오. 그러면 그들은 의욕을 잃고 맙니다.
ko.R: 아버지 여러분, 자녀를 계속 화나게 하지 마십시오. 그러면 자녀들은 애쓰기를 포기해 버립니다.

pt.L: Pais, não provoquem os seus filhos, para que eles não desanimem.
pt.B: Pais, não vivam provocando os seus filhos, para que eles não percam o ânimo.
pt.R: Pais, não deixem os seus filhos com raiva o tempo todo, senão eles vão desistir de tentar.

am.L: አባቶች ሆይ፣ ልጆቻችሁ ተስፋ እንዳይቆርጡ አታስቆጧቸው።
am.B: አባቶች ሆይ፣ ልጆቻችሁን ደጋግማችሁ አታበሳጩ፤ አለበለዚያ ተስፋ ይቆርጣሉ።
am.R: አባቶች ሆይ፣ ልጆቻችሁን ሁልጊዜ አታስቆጧቸው፤ አለበለዚያ መሞከርን ይተዋሉ።

decisions.choice: fathers
decisions.reason: πατέρες usually means fathers, though it can mean parents (Hebrews 11:23). Fathers held the authority in the household, which is why they are addressed.

decisions.choice: provoke ... lose heart: keep stirring them up until they give up
decisions.reason: ἐρεθίζω means to irritate or stir up; the present means doing it again and again. ἀθυμέω is to lose heart, to become discouraged.

decisions.choice: Padres
decisions.reason: Spanish "padres" means both fathers and parents, and verse 20 uses it for parents, where the Greek has a different word. Paul addresses fathers here (m1), the heads of the household; the plain "Padres" is the usual address. A reviewer may want a word that marks fathers explicitly.

decisions.choice: Pais
decisions.reason: Portuguese "pais" means both "fathers" and "parents", as the Greek word can (m1). After "aos seus pais" (parents) in verse 20 a reader may take it as parents here; m1 prefers fathers, but the overlap is in the Greek too, so Portuguese keeps the one word.

source.text: οἱ δοῦλοι, ὑπακούετε κατὰ πάντα τοῖς κατὰ σάρκα κυρίοις, μὴ ἐν ὀφθαλμοδουλίαις, ὡς ἀνθρωπάρεσκοι, ἀλλ’ ἐν ἁπλότητι καρδίας, φοβούμενοι τὸν κύριον.

records.literal_gloss: The slaves, obey in all things the according to flesh masters, not with eye-service as people-pleasers, but in sincerity of heart, fearing the Lord.

en.L: Slaves, obey in all things [your] masters according to the flesh, not with eye-service, as {{gender:people-pleasers|men-pleasers}}, but with sincerity of heart, fearing the Lord.
en.B: Slaves, obey your earthly masters in everything. Do not work only while they are watching, to win their favor, but with an undivided heart, out of reverence for the Lord.
en.R: Slaves, obey your masters here on earth in everything. Do not work hard only when they are watching you, just to make them like you. Work with an honest heart, because you respect the Lord.

es.L: Esclavos, {{plural_you:obedezcan|obedeced}} en todo a [{{plural_you:sus|vuestros}}] amos según la carne, no sirviendo [solo] a la vista, como quienes agradan a {{gender:la gente|los hombres}}, sino con sencillez de corazón, temiendo al Señor.
es.B: Esclavos, {{plural_you:obedezcan|obedeced}} en todo a {{plural_you:sus|vuestros}} amos terrenales. No {{plural_you:trabajen|trabajéis}} solo cuando {{plural_you:los|os}} están mirando, para {{plural_you:ganarse|ganaros}} su favor, sino con un corazón íntegro, por reverencia al Señor.
es.R: Esclavos, {{plural_you:obedezcan|obedeced}} en todo a {{plural_you:sus|vuestros}} amos aquí en la tierra. No {{plural_you:trabajen|trabajéis}} duro solo cuando {{plural_you:los|os}} están mirando, nada más para caerles bien. {{plural_you:Trabajen|Trabajad}} con un corazón honesto, porque {{plural_you:respetan|respetáis}} al Señor.

fr.L: Esclaves, obéissez en toutes choses à [vos] maîtres selon la chair, non en servant pour l’œil, comme pour plaire aux {{gender:humains|hommes}}, mais avec simplicité de cœur, craignant le Seigneur.
fr.B: Esclaves, obéissez en tout à vos maîtres d’ici-bas. Ne travaillez pas seulement quand ils vous regardent, pour gagner leur faveur, mais d’un cœur sans partage, par respect pour le Seigneur.
fr.R: Esclaves, obéissez en tout à vos maîtres sur cette terre. Ne travaillez pas dur seulement quand ils vous regardent, juste pour qu’ils vous apprécient. Travaillez avec un cœur honnête, parce que vous respectez le Seigneur.

sw.L: Watumwa, watiini katika mambo yote mabwana [wenu] kwa jinsi ya mwili, si kwa utumishi wa macho kama wanaowapendeza wanadamu, bali kwa moyo mnyofu, mkimwogopa Bwana.
sw.B: Watumwa, watiini mabwana wenu wa hapa duniani katika kila jambo. Msifanye kazi tu wanapowaangalia, ili kujipatia kibali chao, bali fanyeni kwa moyo usiogawanyika, kwa kumcha Bwana.
sw.R: Watumwa, watiini mabwana wenu wa hapa duniani katika kila jambo. Msifanye kazi kwa bidii tu wanapowatazama, ili wawapende. Fanyeni kazi kwa moyo wa kweli, kwa sababu mnamheshimu Bwana.

vi.L: Những người làm nô lệ, hãy vâng lời trong mọi sự những người chủ theo xác thịt, không phải phục vụ cho vừa mắt người, như những người tìm cách làm vừa lòng người ta, nhưng với lòng thành thật, kính sợ Chúa.
vi.B: Những người làm nô lệ, hãy vâng lời chủ mình ở trần gian trong mọi sự. Đừng chỉ làm việc khi họ đang nhìn, để được lòng họ, nhưng hãy làm với tấm lòng chân thành, vì kính sợ Chúa.
vi.R: Những người làm nô lệ, hãy vâng lời chủ mình ở đời này trong mọi việc. Đừng chỉ chăm chỉ làm việc khi chủ đang nhìn mình, chỉ để được chủ ưa thích. Hãy làm việc với tấm lòng ngay thật, vì anh chị em kính sợ Chúa.

ko.L: 노예 여러분, 육신을 따른 주인들에게 모든 일에 순종하십시오. 사람의 환심을 사려는 사람처럼 눈가림으로 하지 말고, 주님을 두려워하며 순전한 마음으로 [하십시오].
ko.B: 노예 여러분, 이 땅의 주인들에게 모든 일에 순종하십시오. 그들이 보고 있을 때만 그들의 환심을 사려고 일하지 말고, 주님을 경외하는 마음으로 한결같은 마음을 다해 일하십시오.
ko.R: 노예 여러분, 이 땅의 주인들에게 모든 일에 순종하십시오. 주인이 볼 때만 열심히 일하지 마십시오. 그저 주인에게 잘 보이려고 일하지 마십시오. 주님을 존경하는 마음으로 정직하게 일하십시오.

pt.L: Escravos, obedeçam em tudo aos [seus] senhores segundo a carne, não servindo [só] quando são vistos, como quem busca agradar {{gender:às pessoas|aos homens}}, mas com sinceridade de coração, temendo o Senhor.
pt.B: Escravos, obedeçam em tudo aos seus senhores aqui na terra. Não trabalhem só quando eles estão olhando, para ganhar o favor deles, mas com um coração sincero, por reverência ao Senhor.
pt.R: Escravos, obedeçam em tudo aos seus senhores aqui na terra. Não trabalhem duro só quando eles estão olhando, só para que eles gostem de vocês. Trabalhem com um coração honesto, porque vocês respeitam o Senhor.

am.L: ባሪያዎች ሆይ፣ በሥጋ ጌቶቻችሁ ለሆኑት በሁሉ ነገር ታዘዙ፤ ሰውን ደስ እንደሚያሰኙ በዓይን አገልግሎት ሳይሆን ጌታን እየፈራችሁ በቅን ልብ [ታዘዙ]።
am.B: ባሪያዎች ሆይ፣ በምድር ላሉ ጌቶቻችሁ በሁሉ ነገር ታዘዙ። ሞገሳቸውን ለማግኘት እነርሱ ሲመለከቷችሁ ብቻ አትሥሩ፤ ይልቁንም ጌታን በመፍራት በቅን ልብ ሥሩ።
am.R: ባሪያዎች ሆይ፣ በዚህ ምድር ላሉ ጌቶቻችሁ በሁሉ ነገር ታዘዙ። እንዲወዷችሁ ብላችሁ እነርሱ ሲያዩአችሁ ብቻ ጠንክራችሁ አትሥሩ። ጌታን ስለምታከብሩ በቅን ልብ ሥሩ።

decisions.choice: slaves in the Roman world
decisions.reason: Slaves made up a large part of many households. They were legally their owners' property, though many were later freed. Slaves and masters belonged to the same churches (4:1; 4:9, where Onesimus is named; Philemon 10-16). The letter does not discuss whether slavery should exist; it speaks to people inside it and puts slaves and masters under one Lord (3:11; 4:1).

decisions.choice: masters according to the flesh, and the Lord: earthly owners, and Christ, their real Lord
decisions.reason: The same word, κύριος, means both "master" and "Lord". Their owners are masters only κατὰ σάρκα ("according to the flesh"), in this life; the Lord they fear is Christ (verse 24).

decisions.choice: eye-service: working only when watched, to please people
decisions.reason: ὀφθαλμοδουλίαις is first found in Paul's letters (also Ephesians 6:6): service done for the master's eye. ἀνθρωπάρεσκοι are those who aim only to please people.

decisions.choice: follow SBLGNT: "fearing the Lord"
decisions.reason: Many manuscripts read "God". "The Lord" fits verses 23-24.

decisions.choice: masters (the owners); the Lord (Christ)
decisions.reason: One Greek word, two English ones (m2): "masters" for the owners and "Lord" for Christ, so that the contrast shows.

decisions.choice: {{gender:people-pleasers|men-pleasers}}
decisions.reason: The word means pleasing human beings; "men-pleasers" is the traditional form.

decisions.choice: out of reverence for
decisions.reason: The fear meant is reverence (Proverbs 1:7); Literal keeps "fearing".

decisions.choice: en servant pour l’œil, comme pour plaire aux {{gender:humains|hommes}} (L)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the picture of service done for the master's eye (m3), as the English "eye-service" does; the setting is on the noun French needs for "people-pleasers".

decisions.choice: mabwana (the owners); Bwana (Christ)
decisions.reason: Swahili has one word for master and Lord, as the Greek does, so it keeps the Greek wordplay: lowercase "mabwana" for the earthly owners and capital "Bwana" for Christ (m2), where English needs two words.

decisions.choice: slaves
decisions.reason: "Slave" at every level: Paul speaks to slaves as a social class, people actually owned, next to their "masters", and "servant" would change the meaning for modern readers (style guide); m1 says who they were.

decisions.choice: "nô lệ" at every level; "chủ" for the owners and "Chúa" for Christ
decisions.reason: As in 3:11 and the English, Paul speaks to people who were owned, so "nô lệ" stays at every level. One Greek word means both "master" and "Lord" (m2); Vietnamese, like English, needs two, "chủ" and "Chúa", and the contrast shows.

decisions.choice: "những người tìm cách làm vừa lòng người ta", with no gender span
alternatives: a gender span as in the English Literal
decisions.reason: "Người ta" already means people of either sex, so the setting has nothing to change; likewise "người ta" and "loài người" in 3:23.

decisions.choice: "노예" at every level; "주인" for the owners and "주님" for Christ
decisions.reason: Paul speaks to slaves as a class of people actually owned, so the style guide's "노예" is used at every level, as the English keeps "slave". One Greek word means both "master" and "Lord" (the meaning decision); Korean "주인" and "주님" share the syllable "주", so the contrast and the link both show.

decisions.choice: Escravos (every level)
decisions.reason: As the English and the style guide keep it: Paul speaks to slaves as a class of people who were owned (m1), next to their masters, so "servos" would change the meaning. The same holds through 4:1.

decisions.choice: senhores (the owners); o Senhor (Christ)
decisions.reason: Portuguese has the one word, "senhor", for master and Lord, as the Greek does (m2); a lowercase "senhores" for the owners and a capital "Senhor" for Christ keeps the contrast the English makes with two words. "Donos" would be plainer but would lose it.

decisions.choice: ጌቶች (masters) ... ጌታ (the Lord), here, in 3:23-24 and in 4:1
decisions.reason: Amharic, like the Greek, uses one word for an earthly master and for the Lord, so the play of 3:22-4:1 comes through without help: the slaves' masters have a Master in heaven.

decisions.choice: ሰውን ደስ እንደሚያሰኙ (as people-pleasers), with no gender span, here and for "ለሰዎች" in 3:23
decisions.reason: The English offers "men-pleasers" and "men" as alternatives. "ሰው" and "ሰዎች" already mean people, men and women, so there is nothing for the setting to change.

source.text: ὃ ἐὰν ποιῆτε, ἐκ ψυχῆς ἐργάζεσθε, ὡς τῷ κυρίῳ καὶ οὐκ ἀνθρώποις, εἰδότες ὅτι ἀπὸ κυρίου ἀπολήμψεσθε τὴν ἀνταπόδοσιν τῆς κληρονομίας· τῷ κυρίῳ Χριστῷ δουλεύετε·

records.literal_gloss: Whatever you do, from [the] soul work, as to the Lord and not to men, \v 24 knowing that from [the] Lord you will receive the reward of the inheritance; the Lord Christ you serve [as slaves];

en.L: Whatever you do, work [at it] from the soul, as to the Lord and not to {{gender:people|men}}, \v 24 knowing that from [the] Lord you will receive the reward of the inheritance; you are serving the Lord {{christos:Christ|Messiah}} as slaves.
en.B: Whatever you are doing, put your whole self into the work, as for the Lord and not for people, \v 24 knowing that you will receive from the Lord the inheritance as your reward. It is the Lord {{christos:Christ|Messiah}} you serve as slaves.
en.R: Whatever work you do, give it everything you have, as if you were working for the Lord and not for people. \v 24 You know that the Lord will give you a reward: you will receive what {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has promised to {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} people. You are really slaves of the Lord {{christos:Christ|Messiah}}; {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} is the one you are serving.

es.L: Lo que {{plural_you:hagan|hagáis}}, {{plural_you:trabajen|trabajad}} [en ello] desde el alma, como para el Señor y no para {{gender:la gente|los hombres}}, \v 24 sabiendo que del Señor {{plural_you:recibirán|recibiréis}} la recompensa de la herencia; al Señor {{christos:Cristo|Mesías}} {{plural_you:sirven|servís}} como esclavos.
es.B: Todo lo que {{plural_you:estén|estéis}} haciendo, {{plural_you:pongan|poned}} todo {{plural_you:su|vuestro}} ser en el trabajo, como para el Señor y no para la gente, \v 24 sabiendo que del Señor {{plural_you:recibirán|recibiréis}} la herencia como recompensa. Es al Señor {{christos:Cristo|Mesías}} a quien {{plural_you:sirven|servís}} como esclavos.
es.R: Cualquier trabajo que {{plural_you:hagan|hagáis}}, {{plural_you:dedíquenle|dedicadle}} todo lo que {{plural_you:tienen|tenéis}}, como si {{plural_you:trabajaran|trabajarais}} para el Señor y no para la gente. \v 24 {{plural_you:Saben|Sabéis}} que el Señor {{plural_you:les|os}} dará una recompensa: {{plural_you:recibirán|recibiréis}} lo que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} ha prometido a {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} pueblo. En realidad {{plural_you:son|sois}} esclavos del Señor {{christos:Cristo|Mesías}}; {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} es a quien {{plural_you:sirven|servís}}.

fr.L: Quoi que vous fassiez, travaillez-y de toute [votre] âme, comme pour le Seigneur et non pour des {{gender:humains|hommes}}, \v 24 sachant que du Seigneur vous recevrez la récompense de l’héritage ; vous servez comme esclaves le Seigneur {{christos:Christ|Messie}}.
fr.B: Quel que soit votre travail, mettez-y tout votre être, comme pour le Seigneur et non pour des gens, \v 24 sachant que vous recevrez du Seigneur l’héritage comme récompense. C’est le Seigneur {{christos:Christ|Messie}} que vous servez comme esclaves.
fr.R: Quel que soit le travail que vous faites, donnez-y tout ce que vous avez, comme si vous travailliez pour le Seigneur et non pour des gens. \v 24 Vous savez que le Seigneur vous donnera une récompense : vous recevrez ce qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a promis à {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} peuple. En réalité, vous êtes les esclaves du Seigneur {{christos:Christ|Messie}} ; c’est {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} que vous servez.

sw.L: Chochote mnachofanya, fanyeni kazi kutoka nafsini, kama kwa Bwana na si kwa wanadamu, \v 24 mkijua kwamba kutoka kwa Bwana mtapokea thawabu ya urithi; mnatumika kama watumwa wa Bwana {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}.
sw.B: Lolote mnalofanya, lifanyeni kwa moyo wenu wote, kama kwa ajili ya Bwana na si kwa ajili ya watu, \v 24 mkijua kwamba mtapokea urithi kutoka kwa Bwana kuwa thawabu yenu. Ni Bwana {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} mnayemtumikia kama watumwa.
sw.R: Kazi yoyote mnayofanya, ifanyeni kwa nguvu zenu zote, kana kwamba mnamfanyia Bwana kazi, wala si watu. \v 24 Mnajua kwamba Bwana atawapa thawabu: mtapokea yale {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} aliyowaahidi watu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}. Kwa kweli ninyi ni watumwa wa Bwana {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}; {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} ndiye mnayemtumikia.

vi.L: Bất cứ điều gì anh chị em làm, hãy làm việc từ tâm hồn, như cho Chúa chứ không phải cho loài người, \v 24 vì biết rằng anh chị em sẽ nhận từ Chúa phần thưởng là cơ nghiệp; anh chị em đang phục vụ như nô lệ cho Chúa là {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}}.
vi.B: Bất cứ việc gì anh chị em đang làm, hãy dồn hết lòng mình vào công việc, như làm cho Chúa chứ không phải cho người ta, \v 24 vì biết rằng anh chị em sẽ nhận từ Chúa cơ nghiệp làm phần thưởng. Chính Chúa là {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}} mà anh chị em đang phục vụ như nô lệ.
vi.R: Bất cứ công việc gì anh chị em làm, hãy làm hết sức mình, như thể anh chị em đang làm cho Chúa chứ không phải cho người ta. \v 24 Anh chị em biết rằng Chúa sẽ ban phần thưởng cho anh chị em: anh chị em sẽ nhận được điều {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã hứa ban cho dân của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Thật ra anh chị em là nô lệ của Chúa là {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}}; chính {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} là Đấng anh chị em đang phục vụ.

ko.L: 무엇을 하든지, 사람들에게가 아니라 주님께 하는 것처럼 영혼에서 우러나서 일하십시오. \v 24 여러분은 주님께로부터 유산의 보상을 받을 줄 압니다. 여러분은 주 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}를 노예로서 섬기고 있습니다.
ko.B: 무슨 일을 하든지 사람이 아니라 주님을 위해 일하는 마음으로 온 힘을 쏟으십시오. \v 24 여러분은 주님께로부터 유산을 상으로 받게 될 것을 알고 있습니다. 여러분이 노예로서 섬기는 분은 주 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}이십니다.
ko.R: 어떤 일을 하든지, 사람들을 위해서가 아니라 주님을 위해서 일하는 것처럼 최선을 다하십시오. \v 24 주님께서 여러분에게 상을 주실 것을 여러분은 알고 있습니다. 주님께서 그분의 백성에게 약속하신 것을 여러분도 받게 될 것입니다. 여러분은 사실 주 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}의 노예입니다. 여러분이 섬기는 분은 바로 그분이십니다.

pt.L: O que quer que vocês façam, trabalhem [nisso] de toda a alma, como para o Senhor e não para {{gender:as pessoas|os homens}}, \v 24 sabendo que do Senhor vocês receberão a recompensa da herança; vocês servem como escravos ao Senhor {{christos:Cristo|Messias}}.
pt.B: Seja o que for que estiverem fazendo, dediquem-se ao trabalho de todo o coração, como quem trabalha para o Senhor e não para as pessoas, \v 24 sabendo que receberão do Senhor a herança como recompensa. É ao Senhor {{christos:Cristo|Messias}} que vocês servem como escravos.
pt.R: Seja qual for o trabalho que vocês fizerem, façam com toda a dedicação, como se estivessem trabalhando para o Senhor e não para pessoas. \v 24 Vocês sabem que o Senhor vai dar uma recompensa a vocês: vocês vão receber o que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} prometeu ao {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} povo. Na verdade, vocês são escravos do Senhor {{christos:Cristo|Messias}}; é a {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} que vocês estão servindo.

am.L: የምታደርጉትን ሁሉ ለሰዎች ሳይሆን ለጌታ እንደምታደርጉ ከነፍሳችሁ ሥሩት፤ \v 24 የርስትን ዋጋ ከጌታ እንደምትቀበሉ እያወቃችሁ፤ ጌታን {{christos:ክርስቶስን|መሲሕን}} እንደ ባሪያ ታገለግላላችሁ።
am.B: የምትሠሩትን ሁሉ ለሰዎች ሳይሆን ለጌታ እንደምትሠሩ በሙሉ ልባችሁ ሥሩ፤ \v 24 ርስትን ዋጋችሁ አድርጋችሁ ከጌታ እንደምትቀበሉ ታውቃላችሁና። እንደ ባሪያ የምታገለግሉት ጌታን {{christos:ክርስቶስን|መሲሕን}} ነው።
am.R: የምትሠሩት ሥራ ምንም ይሁን ምን፣ ለሰዎች ሳይሆን ለጌታ እንደምትሠሩ ሆናችሁ የምትችሉትን ሁሉ አድርጉ። \v 24 ጌታ ዋጋ እንደሚሰጣችሁ ታውቃላችሁ፤ ለሕዝቡ የገባውን ተስፋ ትቀበላላችሁ። እናንተ በእርግጥ የጌታ {{christos:የክርስቶስ|የመሲሑ}} ባሪያዎች ናችሁ፤ የምታገለግሉት እርሱን ነው።

decisions.choice: from the soul: wholeheartedly
decisions.reason: "From the soul" means with one's whole self (Ephesians 6:6).

decisions.choice: the reward of the inheritance: what slaves could not have, the Lord gives
decisions.reason: In law a slave could own nothing and inherit nothing. Yet the Lord will give these slaves the inheritance of his people (1:12) as their reward.

decisions.choice: you serve the Lord Christ: a statement of fact
alternatives: a command: serve the Lord Christ
decisions.reason: δουλεύετε can be a statement or a command. Many manuscripts add "for", which makes it a statement and the reason for verse 23. The verb is the one for serving as a slave: their true master is Christ.

decisions.choice: the Lord {{christos:Christ|Messiah}}
decisions.reason: Title setting. "The Lord Messiah" is used without "the" before Messiah, since the phrase is a title.

decisions.choice: serve as slaves (L, B); slaves of the Lord Christ (R)
decisions.reason: The verb means to serve as a slave. "Slave" is kept at every level: Paul speaks to slaves as a social class, people actually owned, next to their "masters", and "servant" would change the meaning for modern readers (style guide), and the verse tells them their true master is Christ (m3).

decisions.choice: {{gender:people|men}}
decisions.reason: The word means human beings in general; Balanced and Readable say "people".

decisions.choice: what {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has promised to {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} people
decisions.reason: Readable explains "inheritance" (m2 and 1:12).

decisions.choice: "Chúa là {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}}" for "the Lord Christ"
decisions.reason: Vietnamese joins the two titles with "là" ("the Lord, who is Christ"), and the title setting applies to the second. "Chúa Christ" alone would read as a name.

decisions.choice: "노예로서 섬기다" (L, B); "주 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}의 노예" (R)
decisions.reason: The verb means to serve as a slave, and the point is that their true owner is Christ (the meaning decision). Korean "섬기다" alone loses that, so every level says "노예", the word used for these readers in 3:22.

decisions.choice: o Senhor {{christos:Cristo|Messias}}
decisions.reason: As the English: "o Senhor Messias" is read as one title, so the alternative has no second article.

source.text: ὁ γὰρ ἀδικῶν κομίσεται ὃ ἠδίκησεν, καὶ οὐκ ἔστιν προσωπολημψία.

records.literal_gloss: The [one] for doing wrong will receive back what he did wrong, and there is not partiality.

en.L: For whoever does wrong will be repaid for the wrong done, and there is no partiality.
en.B: Anyone who does wrong will be repaid for that wrong, and there is no favoritism with the Lord.
en.R: Whoever does wrong will be paid back for it. The Lord treats everyone the same.

es.L: Porque el que obra mal recibirá [el pago de] lo que hizo mal, y no hay parcialidad.
es.B: Cualquiera que hace el mal recibirá el pago de ese mal, y con el Señor no hay favoritismos.
es.R: El que hace lo malo recibirá su merecido. El Señor trata a todos por igual.

fr.L: Car celui qui fait le mal recevra ce qu’il a fait de mal, et il n’y a pas d’acception de personnes.
fr.B: Celui qui fait le mal sera payé pour ce mal, et avec le Seigneur il n’y a pas de favoritisme.
fr.R: Celui qui fait le mal recevra ce qu’il mérite. Le Seigneur traite tout le monde de la même façon.

sw.L: Kwa maana anayedhulumu atarudishiwa ile dhuluma aliyoifanya, wala hakuna kuangalia sura [za watu].
sw.B: Kila mtu anayetenda mabaya atalipwa kulingana na ubaya wake, na Bwana hana upendeleo.
sw.R: Mtu anayefanya mabaya atalipwa kwa hilo. Bwana huwatendea watu wote sawa.

vi.L: Vì ai làm điều sai sẽ bị báo trả về điều sai mình đã làm, và không có sự thiên vị.
vi.B: Ai làm điều sai sẽ bị báo trả về điều sai ấy, và Chúa không thiên vị ai.
vi.R: Ai làm điều sai sẽ phải chịu báo trả về điều đó. Chúa đối xử với mọi người như nhau.

ko.L: 불의를 행하는 사람은 자기가 행한 불의를 그대로 돌려받을 것이며, 사람의 얼굴을 보아주는 일은 없습니다.
ko.B: 잘못을 저지르는 사람은 누구든지 그 잘못에 대한 대가를 받을 것이며, 주님께는 편애가 없습니다.
ko.R: 잘못한 사람은 누구나 그만큼 돌려받을 것입니다. 주님께서는 누구든지 똑같이 대하십니다.

pt.L: Pois quem faz o mal receberá de volta o mal que fez, e não há parcialidade.
pt.B: Quem faz o mal receberá a paga pelo mal que fez, e da parte do Senhor não há favoritismo.
pt.R: Quem faz o mal vai receber de volta o mal que fez. O Senhor trata todos da mesma forma.

am.L: ግፍ የሚሠራ የሠራውን ግፍ መልሶ ይቀበላልና፤ አድልዎም የለም።
am.B: ግፍ የሚሠራ ሁሉ ስለ ግፉ ብድራቱን ይቀበላል፤ በጌታ ዘንድ አድልዎ የለም።
am.R: ክፉ የሚያደርግ ሁሉ ስለ ክፋቱ ይከፈለዋል። ጌታ ሁሉንም እኩል ያያል።

decisions.choice: whoever does wrong: anyone, slave or master
alternatives: a master who wrongs his slaves
a slave who cheats his master
decisions.reason: The verse follows the words to slaves, but the next verse (4:1) turns to masters, and Ephesians 6:8-9 applies the same rule to both. No one's status changes how the Lord judges.

decisions.choice: partiality: favoring someone because of who they are
decisions.reason: προσωπολημψία comes from a Hebrew idiom, "to lift the face", meaning to favor a person (Deuteronomy 10:17; Romans 2:11). God does not judge by rank.

decisions.choice: with the Lord; The Lord treats everyone the same
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say whose impartiality is meant (verse 24; Ephesians 6:9).

decisions.choice: acception de personnes (L); favoritisme (B)
decisions.reason: "Faire acception de personnes" is the French phrase built on the same picture as the Hebrew idiom behind the word, judging by the face (m2), so Literal keeps it; Balanced uses the everyday word.

decisions.choice: kuangalia sura [za watu]
decisions.reason: The Greek word is built from "receiving the face": judging by who someone is (m2). Literal keeps the picture with "kuangalia sura"; Balanced and Readable say "upendeleo" and "huwatendea watu wote sawa".

decisions.choice: ግፍ የሚሠራ ... ግፍ (whoever does wrong ... the wrong)
decisions.reason: The verb is about wronging another person, a slave or a master (meaning decision m1). "ግፍ" is injustice done to someone; "በደል" is kept for Paul's word for trespass (2:13). Readable says plainly "ክፉ".
